**What would you like added or changed?**
A clear description of the feature or rule you'd like.

**Why is this useful?**
What financial scenario or gap does this address (e.g. a budgeting case
not currently covered, a usability improvement in the CLI/web UI)?

**Which component would this affect?**
- [ ] Knowledge base / new rule(s)
- [ ] Inference engine
- [ ] Financial calculator
- [ ] Web UI
- [ ] CLI
- [ ] Knowledge acquisition tool
- [ ] Tests / documentation

**Proposed conditions/logic (if suggesting a new rule)**
<!-- e.g. IF debt_to_income_ratio > 0.5 THEN recommend credit counseling -->
